typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsMarkTradesAlreadyInCaly_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		SWDEAL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD
fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD derive({Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of SWDEAL_ID} = SWDEAL_ID,
		{Copy of TRADE_STATUS} = TRADE_STATUS) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		TRADE_ID as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		SWDEAL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRADE_ID = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		TRADE_STATUS = {Copy of TRADE_STATUS},
		SWDEAL_ID = {Copy of SWDEAL_ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsMarkTradesAlreadyInCaly_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsMarkTradesAlreadyInCaly
